messages.subject: "Error: Hessian is singular.  Try using fewer covariates."
parts:
FYI, unmarked users. I was getting this error, which was addressed by
specifying parameter values with the "start" option in the model
statement. Many thanks to Richard and Andy for their help.

correspondence:

Yeah, the default is to start all parameters at 0. Your models look
fine to me.

Thanks again for your interest in unmarked.

Richard

> Hi Matt,
>
> I also got the error, but it can be avoided by providing starting
> values. Try this:
>
> null <- pcount(~obs ~offset(log(area)), umf, starts=c(-1,0,0,0,0,0))
>
> In general to figure out what good starting values might be, you can use:
>
> pcount(~obs ~offset(log(area)), umf, se=FALSE)
>
> Note that one of the observers had a near zero probability of
> detecting COYEs. This is probably what was causing the problem.

> Richard
